topic: Data upload issue for past dates
summary_markdown: The session addressed a data ingestion failure, noting that data failed to upload starting from February 28th. [me] fixed the `data-api` and ran the `recalc - upload only` job. However, it was determined that a script was needed to backfill the missing data for previous days across all relevant countries.
decisions: A dedicated script is required to run the historical data upload process for all countries.
action_items: [p1] will run the necessary script and upload the historical data in the morning.
